FEET_STAY_LEVEL.bar: HQ's line (rig-c/parts#347 ruling 4), not a figure measured here
FEET_STAY_LEVEL.reason: no frame of "idle", "tilt", "look_l", "look_r", "smile", "startled", "wave", "hop" turns a bone above "body_motion" (which "shoes" rides), so no foot was seen while its leg was posed

CLOTH_SETTLES.floor: a chain settles at the first frame from which its tip moves slower than 0.01694 rig px/s to the idle's last frame — half the slowest tip an idle key drives on the public examples (scarf's skirt_l2, 0.03388 rig px/s)
CLOTH_SETTLES.levers: a chain at rest moves again when the world or the body does: an environment at render (rigc render --environment, wind and gravity in time; AUTHORING §3, What moves them, has a worked schedule) or a consumer's animation that moves the bone it hangs from; the drafted idle keys no hip (rig-c/parts#502)

PHYSICS_CONTRIBUTES.off: the same compiled build posed with the poser's physics off (spine-core Physics.none, rig-c physicsMode 'off') over the same frames — not the rig spec with its physics constraints stripped and built again
PHYSICS_CONTRIBUTES.points: every vertex of a rest triangle that holds a pixel centre of the part's art (alpha above the mesh threshold); per frame the largest residual over them, frames 1..N-1

PART_SUPPORT_REPORT.pair_registration: pre-rig parts.json placements, setup slot order
PART_SUPPORT_REPORT.unowned_registration: official renderer setup, native stage grid
